'task.ind.tat.warning.threshold.upper.hrs'), role_hierarchy_cte as( SELECT DISTINCT user_data.user_id, user_data.user_role FROM mfi_reporting.credit_user_role_hierarchy curh JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer on uer.user_id = 1 ::bigint, LATERAL ( VALUES (curh.l6_user_id, 'CU_L6'), (curh.l5_user_id, 'CU_L5'), (curh.l4_user_id, 'CU_L4'), (curh.l3_user_id, 'CU_L3'), (curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6', 'CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0')) ) SELECT 'GROUP' AS record_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= jlg.prop_value::DECIMAL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= shg.prop_value::DECIMAL) THEN lcb.group_id END) AS tat_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > jlg.prop_value::DECIMAL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > shg.prop_value::DECIMAL) THEN lcb.group_id END) AS tat_not_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= 24 THEN lcb.group_id END) AS wip_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > 24 THEN lcb.group_id END) AS wip_greater_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' THEN lcb.group_id END) AS wip, SUM(CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' OR lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') THEN lafdst.requested_amount END) AS login_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lcb.group_id END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lcb.group_id END) AS approved_disbursed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_disbursed_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status NOT IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lcb.group_id END) AS approved_not_disbursed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status NOT IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment Reinitiation Maker Pending') THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_not_disbursed_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.group_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED' THEN lcb.group_id END) AS reject_count FROM mfi_reporting.los_credit_base lcb JOIN mfi_los.group__member_details gmd ON gmd.group_id = lcb.group_id LEFT JOIN mfi_reporting.loan_app_financial_details_staging_table lafdst ON lafdst.loan_app_id = gmd.loan_app_id LEFT JOIN mfi_reporting.los_credit_base credit ON credit.group_id = lcb.group_id AND credit.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND credit.is_next_stage_created IS TRUE LEFT JOIN jlg_tat_hour jlg ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN shg_tat_hour shg ON 1 = 1 JOIN role_hierarchy_cte rhc ON rhc.user_id = lcb.assignee_contributor and rhc.user_id is not null;

mfi_masterdata."configuration" where prop_key = 'task.shg.tat.warning.threshold.upper.hrs'), ind_tat_hour as (select prop_value from mfi_masterdata."configuration" where prop_key = 'task.ind.tat.warning.threshold.upper.hrs'), role_hierarchy_cte as( SELECT DISTINCT user_data.user_id, user_data.user_role FROM mfi_reporting.credit_user_role_hierarchy curh JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer on uer.user_id = 1 ::bigint, LATERAL ( VALUES (curh.l6_user_id, 'CU_L6'), (curh.l5_user_id, 'CU_L5'), (curh.l4_user_id, 'CU_L4'), (curh.l3_user_id, 'CU_L3'), (curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6', 'CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1', 'CU_L0')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0')) ) SELECT 'INDV' AS record_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= ind.prop_value::DECIMAL THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS tat_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > ind.prop_value::DECIMAL THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS tat_not_met_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 <= 24 THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS wip_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (lcb.final_action_date::timestamp - lcb.task_created_on::timestamp)) / 3600 > 24 THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS wip_greater_1day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS wip, SUM(CASE WHEN lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' AND (lcb.final_status = 'ASSIGNED' OR lcb.is_next_stage_created is true OR lcb.final_status = 'REJECTED') THEN lafdst.requested_amount END) AS login_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lcb.loan_app_id END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lcb.task_name = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' THEN lafdst.approved_amount END) AS approved_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN credit.loan_app_id IS NOT NULL AND lafdst.status IN ('Disbursed', 'Payment Reinitiation Rejected', 'Payment Reinitiation Checker Pending', 'Payment queries.sqlPreview: WITH role_hierarchy_cte AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_data.user_id, user_data.user_role FROM mfi_reporting.credit_user_role_hierarchy curh JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer on uer.user_id = 1 ::bigint , LATERAL ( VALUES (curh.l6_user_id, 'CU_L6'), (curh.l5_user_id, 'CU_L5'), (curh.l4_user_id, 'CU_L4'), (curh.l3_user_id, 'CU_L3'), (curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0'), (curh.cfe_user_id, 'CFE') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6','CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5','CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4','CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3','CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2','CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1','CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0','CFE')) ), rejections_data AS ( select count(la.loan_app_id) as reject_count, la.reject_reason AS reject_reason FROM mfi_reporting.loan_app_stage_staging_table la JOIN mfi_reporting.office_details od ON la.office_id = od.id JOIN mfi_actor.country_state_district csd ON od.state = csd."name" AND csd.level_id = 2 JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer ON uer.user_id::text = la.rejected_by JOIN role_hierarchy_cte rhc ON rhc.user_id = uer.user_id WHERE la.reject_stage IN ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Conduct BET/SHG Rating', 'Conduct PD') AND la.reject_reason != '' AND la.reject_reason IS NOT null and 1=1 GROUP BY la.reject_reason ), total_rejections AS ( SELECT sum(reject_count) AS total_rejection_count FROM rejections_data ) , ranked AS ( SELECT rejections_data.reject_reason, ROUND( (SUM(rejections_data.reject_count) * 100.0) / (SELECT total_rejection_count FROM total_rejections), 2 ) AS rejection_percentage FROM rejections_data GROUP BY rejections_data.reject_reason ) SELECT reject_reason, CONCAT(rejection_percentage, '%') AS rejection_percentage FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(rejection_percentage), 2), '%') FROM ranked;

queries.sqlPreview: WITH role_hierarchy_cte AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_data.user_id, user_data.user_role FROM mfi_reporting.credit_user_role_hierarchy curh JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer on uer.user_id = 1 ::bigint , LATERAL ( VALUES (curh.l6_user_id, 'CU_L6'), (curh.l5_user_id, 'CU_L5'), (curh.l4_user_id, 'CU_L4'), (curh.l3_user_id, 'CU_L3'), (curh.l2_user_id, 'CU_L2'), (curh.l1_user_id, 'CU_L1'), (curh.l0_user_id, 'CU_L0'), (curh.cfe_user_id, 'CFE') ) AS user_data(user_id, user_role) WHERE (uer.role_code = 'CU_L6' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L6','CU_L5', 'CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L5' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L5','CU_L4', 'CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L4' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L4','CU_L3', 'CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L3' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L3','CU_L2', 'CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L2' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L2','CU_L1', 'CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L1' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L1','CU_L0', 'CFE')) OR (uer.role_code = 'CU_L0' AND user_data.user_role IN ('CU_L0','CFE')) ), rejection_data AS ( SELECT gd.reject_reason AS reject_reason, COUNT(gd.group_id) AS rejection_count FROM mfi_reporting.loan_app_stage_staging_table gd JOIN mfi_reporting.office_details od ON gd.office_id = od.id JOIN mfi_actor.country_state_district csd ON od.state = csd."name" AND csd.level_id = 2 JOIN mfi_reporting.user_employee_role uer ON uer.user_id::text = gd.rejected_by JOIN role_hierarchy_cte rhc ON rhc.user_id = uer.user_id WHERE gd.reject_stage IN ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Conduct BET', 'Conduct PD','Conduct BET/SHG Rating') AND gd.reject_reason IS NOT NULL AND gd.reject_reason <> '' and gd.product_code IN ('JLGDL', 'SHGDL') and 1=1 GROUP BY gd.reject_reason ), total_rejections AS ( SELECT SUM(rejection_count) AS total_rejection_count FROM rejection_data ), ranked AS ( SELECT rejection_data.reject_reason, SUM(rejection_data.rejection_count) AS rejection_count, ROUND( (SUM(rejection_data.rejection_count) * 100.0) / (SELECT total_rejection_count FROM total_rejections), 2 ) AS rejection_percentage FROM rejection_data GROUP BY rejection_data.reject_reason ) SELECT reject_reason, CONCAT(rejection_percentage, '%') AS rejection_percentage FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(rejection_percentage), 2), '%') FROM ranked;

queries.sqlPreview: COPY ( WITH params AS ( SELECT (CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM <sqlDate>::date) = 1 THEN (date_trunc('month', <sqlDate>::date) - interval '1 month')::date ELSE date_trunc('month', <sqlDate>::date)::date END) AS start_date, (<sqlDate>::date - interval '1 day')::date AS end_date ), master_details AS ( SELECT cmd.code, cmd.value FROM mfi_masterdata.code_master cm JOIN mfi_masterdata.code_master_details cmd ON cm.id = cmd.code_master_id WHERE cm.data_type = 'REJECTION_REASON' and cm.data_sub_type='ALL_REASONS' ), user_details as ( select u.id as user_id,e.id as emp_id,concat_ws(' ',e.first_name,e.middle_name,e.last_name) as emp_name, e.formatted_id,e.role_code from mfi_actor.user u join mfi_actor.employee e on u.actor_id = e.actor_id ), office_details as( SELECT od.id AS office_id, od.formatted_id AS branch_code, od."name" AS branch, csd.state AS state, csd.region FROM mfi_actor.office od JOIN mfi_actor.office__address__mapping oam ON oam.office_id = od.id JOIN mfi_actor.address a ON a.id = oam.address_id AND a."type" = 'ADD_TYP_004' JOIN mfi_actor.village_town_city vtc ON vtc.hierarchy_element_id = a.geo_element_id JOIN mfi_actor.csd_vtc_flat_tbl csd ON csd.vtc_id = vtc.id AND csd.is_deleted = false ), latest_loan_rejected AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (la.id) la.*,gd.id as group_id,gd.formatted_id as group_formatted_id FROM mfi_los.loan_app la left join mfi_los.group__member_details gmd on la.id = gmd.loan_app_id left join mfi_los.group_details gd on gmd.group_id = gd.id CROSS JOIN params p WHERE la.status in ('Rejected', 'CM Rejected Review Finalization', 'Cancelled') AND coalesce(la.rejected_on::date, la.updated_on::date) >= p.start_date AND coalesce(la.rejected_on::date, la.updated_on::date) <= p.end_date order by la.id,gmd.updated_on desc ), cu_decisions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (lacmd.group_id, lacmd.loan_app_id) lacmd.group_id, lacmd.loan_app_id, lacmd.cu_decision, lr.loan_product_category FROM latest_loan_rejected lr left JOIN mfi_los.loan_app__cu_member_details lacmd ON lacmd.loan_app_id = lr.id and coalesce (lacmd.group_id,0) = coalesce(lr.group_id,0) ORDER BY lacmd.group_id, lacmd.loan_app_id, lacmd.created_on DESC ), bet_decisions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (labd.group_id, labd.loan_app_id) labd.group_id, labd.loan_app_id, labd.bet_decision FROM latest_loan_rejected lr left JOIN mfi_los.loan_app__bet_details labd ON labd.loan_app_id = lr.id and coalesce(labd.group_id,0) = coalesce(lr.group_id,0) ORDER BY labd.group_id, labd.loan_app_id, labd.created_on DESC ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (llr.id) llr.formatted_id AS loan_application_id, CASE WHEN llr.group_formatted_id IS NULL OR llr.group_formatted_id = '0' THEN '' ELSE llr.group_formatted_id END AS group_id, TO_CHAR(llr.created_on, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS login_month, llr.loan_product_category, llr.status as loan_status, b.first_name || ' ' || b.middle_name || ' ' || b.last_name AS borrower_name, od.state AS state, od.branch AS branch_name, od.branch_code AS branch_code, llr.vtc_id AS village_id, csd.village_name AS village_name, so_user.formatted_id AS so_user_id, so_user.emp_name AS so_employee_name, case when llr.status in ('CM Rejected Review Finalization') then 'Credit UnderWriting Pending' else llr.rejected_stage end AS "rejection/delink_stage", CASE WHEN cud.cu_decision IS NOT NULL THEN cud.cu_decision WHEN bed.bet_decision IS NOT NULL THEN bed.bet_decision ELSE ' ' END AS decision_type_member_level, regexp_replace(CASE WHEN md_loan.value IS NOT NULL THEN md_loan.value WHEN md_loan.value IS NULL AND llr.reject_reason IS NOT NULL THEN llr.reject_reason WHEN md_loan.value IS NULL THEN ' ' WHEN md_loan.value = '' THEN ' ' ELSE md_loan.value END, E'[\r\n]+', ' ', 'g') AS "Reject/delink_member_level_reason", regexp_replace(coalesce(llr.extensible_json_data::json->>'reject_notes', ''), E'[\r\n]+', ' ', 'g') AS "Reject/delink_member_level_remarks", rej_user.emp_name AS rejected_user_name, rej_user.formatted_id AS rejected_user_id, rej_user.role_code AS rejected_user_role, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(llr.rejected_on, llr.updated_on)::timestamp, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS rejected_on FROM latest_loan_rejected llr LEFT JOIN master_details md_loan ON llr.reject_reason = md_loan.code join user_details rej_user on coalesce(llr.rejected_by::bigint,llr.updated_by::bigint) = rej_user.user_id join office_details od on llr.office_id = od.office_id join user_details so_user on llr.employee_id = so_user.emp_id join mfi_actor.csd_vtc_flat_tbl csd ON csd.vtc_id = llr.vtc_id AND csd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN cu_decisions cud ON cud.loan_app_id = llr.id AND coalesce(cud.group_id,0) = coalesce(llr.group_id,0) LEFT JOIN bet_decisions bed ON bed.loan_app_id = llr.id AND coalesce(bed.group_id,0) = coalesce(llr.group_id,0) JOIN mfi_los.borrower b on b.loan_app_id = llr.id and b.borrower_type='BORROWER' order by llr.id,llr.group_id desc ) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT CSV, DELIMITER ',', NULL '', QUOTE '"', ESCAPE '"', FORCE_QUOTE *)
